original_five_model_estimate.estimate_basis: Earlier High panels across four OpenAI models (156 attempts) overlapped roughly 17 account percentage points; three fresh prompt conditions require 468 OpenAI attempts. Broad range allows model substitution, hint effects, account rounding and orchestration; this is not a token-to-quota formula.
